apps.localizedDescription:
Download and repost Instagram media, browse Stories and DMs privately, hide ads, customize the app, and record calls—all inside Instagram.

- Hide Rocket buttons from screenshots with Discreet mode
- Prevent videos from playing automatically in the Home feed
- Download Feed media, Reels, profile videos, Stories, Instants, and supported DM visual messages
- Replay Instants without limits and upload Instants from your Photos library
- Manage account-specific downloads with previews, filters, sharing, retries, and bulk deletion
- Repost Feed posts and Reels, copy captions, comments, and media links, and open media full-screen
- Browse Stories and DMs privately with control over seen, playback, typing, and screenshot behavior
- Search story viewers list on your Stories
- Hide sponsored posts, Reels, and Stories
- Switch the home feed between List and Grid layouts
- Watch Reels in Picture in Picture
- Prevent doomscrolling by disabling infinite scrolling Reels
- Make web addresses clickable
- Create settings profiles and automatically apply them to mapped Instagram accounts
- Customize Instagram with themes, custom fonts, and custom icons
- Customize Feed layouts, Reels auto-scroll, like confirmations, dates, and the tab bar
- See follow-back status, enlarge profile pictures, and locally customize your profile stats
- Record Instagram voice calls as audio and video calls with participant video and call audio

versions.localizedDescription:
This update adds profile watching, bulk profile downloads, and cache cleanup! ✨

- Added “Watch profile” to automatically save new posts, Stories, and Reels from selected profiles.
- Added “Save all posts” to download a profile’s posts, including every carousel item.
- Added “Clean cache” to view cache storage usage and clear cached files from Rocket settings.
- Added separate controls for showing profile image, clipboard, and profile stats actions.
- Refreshed Rocket settings to match Instagram’s design, with direct shortcuts to downloads and call recordings.

This update adds deleted message retention! ✨

- Added “Retain deleted messages” to keep received messages on your device when the sender unsends them.
- Fixed Reels switching to the Home feed when returning to the app.
- Fixed “Mark as seen” being blocked in group conversations containing someone excluded from anonymous viewing.
